analysis_options.entrypoint: Direct invocation of the production boundary Funcdata::opHeritage (funcdata.hh:462) once per case on a fresh Funcdata; no Action tree, no C emission; the pass counter is read after the call (C++ getHeritagePass / Rust num_heritage_passes)
analysis_options.prestate: Per-case fresh Funcdata built through production APIs (newOp/opSetOpcode/opSetInput/opSetOutput/newUniqueOut/newConstant/newVarnode/opInsertEnd/newBlockBasic/addEdge). Both sides apply the startProcessing steps a synthetic graph can reach: structureLoops+calcForwardDominator (Ghidra) mirrors as find_spanning_tree (BLOCK-INDEX-ASSIGN-0001, block.cc:1009-1135 reverse-post-order indices) + BlockGraph::build_dom_tree, then heritage.buildInfoList (funcdata.cc:166). Each BOOL flag read is a fresh free Varnode with exactly one descendant, mirroring the PcodeEmitFd::dump single-descendant invariant (funcdata.cc:878-908)
analysis_options.observation: Per case: pass counter; live op count; bool_in (descriptor of the BOOL op's flag input after rename); free_with_reader (whole-bank census of free Varnodes with descendants — the varnode.cc:334-336 throw precondition); phi projection (every parented MULTIEQUAL in block-index then block-op-position order with output descriptor, per-slot input descriptor and the merge block's in-edge j predecessor index); full op list in SeqNum order as name.OPCODE(input descriptors); sorted Varnode descriptor multiset. The Rust comparand additionally asserts (abort on violation, no stdout) the same invariants over the DIRECT production route Funcdata::run_heritage_direct (place_multiequals_direct + rename_direct): BOOL input not free and zero free-with-reader
analysis_options.normalization: No order, flag, list, or membership normalization; absolute unique-space offsets are not printed because allocation bases differ between the implementations; descriptors carry space class, offset or size, def-use class, and defining opcode

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators over architecture, compiler_spec, analysis_options, and cases
